description:
🍍 Piña Colada Ice Cream (Sugar-Free!) 🍒🥥 | Boozy Pineapple Swirl & Homemade Glacé Cherries

This week, we’re going tropical and sugar-free! (ice cream only) 🌴
Get ready for the ultimate summer treat: Piña Colada Ice Cream packed with juicy homemade glacé cherries and a boozy pineapple swirl. It’s creamy, dreamy, and 100% delicious.

If you love piña coladas and want a sugar free no dairy coconut ice cream, this is for you. 
You could possibly use allulose or another sugar substitute for the cherries but I didn't have enough so just used table sugar. 

🕒 Timestamps:
0:00 – Intro: Sugar-Free Piña Colada Heaven
2:02 – The Pinapple bit
2:38 – The Cherry bit
4:20 – Adding rum to the pineapple
7:20 - The ice cream base
9:27 - Cherries are ready!
10:13 - Spin and dish
11:03 – The Grand Reveal & Taste Test
11:30 - The cherry recipe used: https://tinyurl.com/4zpjxefx
12:46 - Outro

——————

Ingredients:
Coconut cream: 165 g
Coconut milk: 439 g
Water: 20 g (used to top up the liquid)
Inulin: 37 g
Erythritol: 12 g (do not increase it will inhibit freezing)
Allulose: 90 g (If using xylitol instead: reduce to 55 g)
Xanthan gum: 2.5 g

Candied Cherries:
Fresh cherries (with pits): 400 g (before pitting)
Sugar: 200 g
Water: Small splash to help dissolve sugar
Invert sugar or corn syrup (optional)
You can substitute with glucose syrup or golden syrup

Pineapple Sauce:
Canned pineapple in juice 1 × 540 ml can use both fruit & juice
Rum: 75 g add after cooling Xanthan gum: 3 g

Dairy and sugar version:
133g coconut cream
354g coconut milk
81g whipping cream
122g sugar
40g smp
12g erythritol 
5g guar

⸻

🧊 Keywords & Tags:
piña colada ice cream, sugar free ice cream, keto ice cream, boozy pineapple swirl, homemade glace cherries, low carb dessert, tropical ice cream recipe, summer dessert ideas, no sugar added ice cream, healthy ice cream recipe, homemade frozen treats, diabetic friendly dessert, coconut pineapple ice cream

⸻

Why you’ll love it:
✔ Tastes like a tropical vacation in a cone
✔ Sugar-free but incredibly sweet & creamy
✔ Homemade glacé cherries (no neon red weirdness!)
✔ Boozy swirl that’s next-level indulgent 

⸻

comments.text: Thanks for the great videos. I've been binge watching your channel over the past few days, and on this one I'm REALLY curious about the level of guar gum in your dairy recipe for the ice cream. Is 5g correct, or is that a mistake? It seemed really high to me, so I input the recipe into Scoopulator and 5g in that recipe is represents a level of 0.67%, which is well over the normally recommended level of 0.1% for guar gum. So I was just curious why so much was recommended for this recipe? As a reference, I made my own recipe (using Scoopulator) and used 3.5g of guar in mine, and it was still very gummy, so I'd think that 5g would be even worse? Thanks!!!
comments.author: @tylerstoehr4034

comments.text: That’s one of the issues with such calculators. AI can’t determine how much stabilizer to use based on complete recipes, they just say “recommended amount”. As every recipe is different,  this one needs more stabilizer to create that same mouth feel.
